text.content:
The unfinished stadium Barghest took, and kept.

Region: The Occupied Zone, Pacifica
Controlled by: Barghest Militia
The feel of it: Fortress, barracks and parade ground
Danger: SC 10: Barghest, Hardened Heavy

Built in the Pacifica resort boom with Petrochem's name on it, and taken unfinished by Barghest in Operation Midnight Storm in spring 2070. It is the heart of the Occupied Zone, and Kurt Hansen gives speeches from the press box. The Pacifica Line's Stadium spur is suspended.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 12
